hypothesis: Frozen64-dimensional GaussianGPT states, coordinate-aligned causal temporal CNN, prefix-visible QFormer and LFQ reconstruct adjacent changes while remaining invariant to later GS inputs.
scope: Conditional causality given cached GS states; oracle posterior action encoding of t->t+1 using at most10 consecutive states ending at t+1. No AR training or raw-video causality claim.
data: All177 NeoVerse states of buildingblock_tower_17_176 and176 adjacent pairs t->t+1

qformer.endpoint_input: Causal CNN feature64, current frozen state feature64, previous-step difference64, current/previous occupancy2, localdt1; fused195->64 then prefix attention
qformer.spatial_position: Fourier3D plus relative time age; both64; causal prefix keys only
qformer.implementation: Shared width64 cross-attention QFormer, two layers, four16-dimensional heads, FFN256. Four learned query slots for each adjacent transition; prefix keys with padding mask. No temporal or batch normalization.

motion_quantizer.fairness: LFQ-only. Previous native64 pair model is context reference; addition of temporalCNN and history changes the hypothesis. No isolated attribution of improvement without controls.

state_quantizer: None: continuous frozen encoder features are used directly
condition: Decoder reads initial integer sparse coordinates and continuous Nx64 features, four LFQ motion IDs and dt only; no future coordinates/features at decode

support.rule: Chebyshev dilation of initial coarse latent coordinates only
support.future_coverage: 100% of all176 adjacent TRAIN endpoint supports must be covered; otherwise stop without truncation
support.calibration_evidence: Every one of176 adjacent TRAIN pairs must have100% target support covered by the fixed initial-only radius6 domain

train.batch: Four adjacent target transitions per update, each with all consecutive context states up to10 ending at target. Joint LFQ over B*K=16 tokens; mean reconstruction loss over4 targets. No gradient accumulation or temporal stride.
train.frozen: Entire new continuous state E/D including adapters and GS heads; LFQ removed; parameter hashes checked
train.target_support: Target support may force coarse-state keep during warmup and first 80% of total training only; final 20% and ALL evaluation use predicted support alone. GaussianGPT decoder is always eval, target_key=None.
train.checkpoint_recovery: Atomic every50 updates, first update, final and caught exceptions/SIGTERM. Includes optimizer, sampler cursor, RNG and phase. No automatic resume.
train.occupancy_loss: Weighted BCE(raw_logit + log(positive_weight), label, pos_weight=positive_weight), positive_weight clipped to [1,50]; inference keeps raw_logit>0 using no target statistics.
train.exposure_comparison: 750 updates x4 target transitions=3000 supervised pair exposures, same as prior native64 run; additional history input is explicitly counted.

evaluation.arms: One causal64 LFQ arm; all176 adjacent targets, including initial short prefixes; no dropped frames.
controls: Initial state held fixed, rendered at target camera
Frozen GaussianGPT encoding of target instant
Motion IDs circularly shifted by 85 start frames within the same clip
Same trained model with history truncated to its last two states (post-hoc context diagnostic, not retrained ablation)
evaluation.regions: NeoVerse state protocol fixed workspace/object/hand-activity boxes
artifacts: motion features before/after quantization Bx4x64 (diagnostics only; not AR Z)
AR action Z: integer IDs Bx4; all177 frames yield176 transitions and704 IDs per sequence
replay packets containing initial continuous state andmotionIDs
six-column videos at source29.97fps: real, hold, frozen, correct-prefixZ, shuffledZ, two-frame-contextZ
causality_checks: Perturb future features and coordinates after selected cutoff
Compare full-window prefix result to physically truncated window
Verify in eval and train modes; hard motion IDs unchanged
evaluation.history_diagnostic: Report history-vs-two-frame ID change fraction and render metric differences; gradient/use is not assumed to imply benefit.

stop: Any occupancy budget exceeded or empty predicted support
Target support outside initial-only candidate domain
retries: No automatic retry, no point/frame truncation, no scientific parameter retuning
limitations: Oracle posterior sees true target endpoint
NeoVerse is an offline whole-video noncausal teacher
Single historically DEV source already admitted to training; reconstruction only
State codec quality reported separately; motion may run diagnostically if state fidelity gate fails but API succeeds
State features are continuous and larger than prior LFQ packets; no discrete-state compression claim
The frozen state codec already failed its fidelity gate (31.267 vs teacher35.637 dB full-frame); this is a diagnostic motion experiment, not evidence of a usable full world model.
Causality is conditional on GS input states, not the upstream offline whole-video NeoVerse teacher.
A10-frame finite context replaces full unbounded history; frame stride remains1.
TemporalCNN is factorized world-coordinate-aligned temporalConv1d after GaussianGPT spatial encoding; not a copy of VideoWorld imageConv3d architecture.
Each sampled target is supervised once per visit; other states in its window supply context, not extra decoded targets.
Post-hoc two-frame-context diagnostic is not a separately trained temporal ablation.

decoder_resource_limits.rationale: Output sparse convolution preserves coordinates after pruning; 600000 candidate voxels times existing multiplier 4 gives a consistent GS bound. No point truncation or pruning-threshold change.

causal_temporal.input_fusion: LayerNorm65 and Linear65->64 for feature64 plus occupancy1
causal_temporal.normalization: LayerNorm64 independently at each time/coordinate; no statistics across time, points or batch
causal_temporal.alignment: Exact shared integer coarse-world voxel coordinates; zero features plus occupancy for absent positions. Full-window union is an index only; unseen columns masked and each prefix selects only positions seen by that time. No spatial mixing across union columns inside temporal CNN.
causal_temporal.prefix: Each transition query reads keys only from window start through its target t+1, inclusive; earlier history is bounded to max10 states. Four queries per transition share one QFormer over all temporal offsets.
causal_temporal.time_position: Relative age to target endpoint, encoded into64 channels; no absolute frame index
causal_temporal.decoder: One-step source-state-conditioned restorer; only initial state plus current motion IDs anddt. Frozen spatial GaussianGPT decoder unchanged.
